
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/21381383" title="发布于 2026-07-12 14:17">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AtCoder-abc466_f Many Mod Calculation 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="形式化题意">形式化题意</h2>
<p>设</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[f(x)=(\dots((x\bmod A_1)\bmod A_2)\dots)\bmod A_n
\]</div><p></p><p>即依次对 <span class="math inline">\(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_n\)</span> 取模。</p>
<p>求</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[\sum_{k=1}^{X}[f(k)=0]
\]</div><p></p><p>的值。</p>
<h2 id="solution">Solution</h2>
<p>考虑所有 <span class="math inline">\(x = 0,1,\dots,X\)</span> 依次对 <span class="math inline">\(A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N\)</span> 取模的过程。初始时这些数构成一个半开区间 <span class="math inline">\([0, X+1)\)</span>。第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 步对 <span class="math inline">\(A_i\)</span> 取模，会把当前每个区间 <span class="math inline">\([0,d)\)</span> 分拆成：</p>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(\lfloor d/A_i\rfloor\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\([0,A_i)\)</span></li>
<li><span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\([0,d\bmod A_i)\)</span>（<strong>若 <span class="math inline">\(d\bmod A_i\neq 0\)</span></strong>）</li>
</ul>
<p>我们可以维护所有区间并将右端点相同的区间合并。具体地，用一个 <code>map</code> 维护每个右端点 <span class="math inline">\(d\)</span> 对应的区间 <span class="math inline">\([0,d)\)</span> 出现次数。然后直接按照上述过程模拟即可。</p>
<p>复杂度分析：第 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span> 步中，对于区间 <span class="math inline">\([0,d)\)</span> 取模 <span class="math inline">\(A_i\)</span> 时若 <span class="math inline">\(d\ge A_i\)</span> 则必有 <span class="math inline">\(d\bmod A_i&lt;d/2\)</span>。这一步还会产生 <span class="math inline">\([0,A_i)\)</span> 区间。因此在整个过程中出现过的本质不同区间共有 <span class="math inline">\(O(N\log X)\)</span> 个，因此总时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(N\log X\log N)\)</span>。</p>
<h2 id="code">Code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define rept(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;=b;++i)
#define fi first
#define se second
#define int long long
using namespace std;
constexpr int N=2e5+5;
int n,x,a[N];
map&lt;int,int,greater&lt;int&gt;&gt; mp;
void solve(){
    cin&gt;&gt;n&gt;&gt;x;
    mp.clear();
    mp[x+1]=1;
    rept(i,1,n) cin&gt;&gt;a[i];
    rept(i,1,n){
        for(auto it=mp.begin();it!=mp.end();++it){
            if(it-&gt;fi&lt;=a[i]) break;
            int q=it-&gt;fi/a[i],r=it-&gt;fi%a[i];
            mp[a[i]]+=q*it-&gt;se;
            if(r) mp[r]+=it-&gt;se;
        }
        while(mp.begin()-&gt;fi&gt;a[i]) mp.erase(mp.begin());
    }
    int ans=0;
    for(auto it=mp.begin();it!=mp.end();++it){
        ans+=it-&gt;se;
    }
    cout&lt;&lt;ans-1&lt;&lt;'\n';
}
signed main(){
    int T;
    cin&gt;&gt;T;
    while(T--) solve();
    return 0;
}
</code></pre>


</div>
